The villa

In country style, a villa with a private pool, sunny terraces facing Trizonia and all the comfort of a home that is waiting for you.

Fully equipped to enjoy not only your breakfast but complete meals, Sun Villa welcomes your family or friends into the comfort and luxury of its spaces. Air-conditioned rooms, carefully chosen bath products for absolute relaxation, sunny terraces over the picturesque island of Trizonia and comfortable loungers by the pool promise a truly high-level holiday.

Ask us and we will gladly offer you genuine local products — and for your little ones, just let us know in good time about anything they need.

Spaces

Every corner, exactly as it is.

The heart of the villa

A large, deep pool with loungers, poufs and two pergola lounges, in a garden of oleanders and fruit trees — with ping-pong on the lawn.

For breakfasts and full meals

A bright living room with sea views, fireplace, dining table and a fully equipped kitchen with coffee machine, oven and a door to the garden.

Four rooms, quiet and cool

Air-conditioned bedrooms in white and sea blue, overlooking the garden and the gulf — and a colourful children’s room.

Care in the details

Three bathrooms with walk-in showers, towels and selected bath products, and little touches of the sea in every corner.

When the lights come on

At dusk the pool lights up, the lanterns glow and the terraces look out over the lights of the Corinthian Gulf.

The area

Glyfada, Trizonia & beyond.

Friendly people, coastal walking and cycling paths, and beaches perfect for inflatables — with the island of Trizonia a breath away.

  • nearby

    Glyfada beach & the boat to Trizonia

    By the beach you will find a supermarket, a pharmacy, a butcher with local meats and tavernas facing the lit-up island. The local boat to Trizonia leaves from here.

  • island

    Trizonia

    The green island of the Corinthian Gulf, where vehicles are not allowed. After the last taverna the beach and its beach bar begin; to the south-east, Punta with its red sand; to the west, Aspra Halikia.

  • 2km

    Sergoula

    Crystal-clear water, a few minutes’ drive away.

  • 2,2km

    Ancient fortification of Glyfada

    A short walk into local history, very close to the villa.

  • —

    Monastiraki & the «Blue Lake»

    The picturesque local beach with its beach bar of the same name.

  • 24km

    Nafpaktos

    Atmospheric evenings in the bars below the castle.

  • day trip

    Delphi

    An excursion not to miss — the landscape and the ancient temples will reward you.

  • 86km

    Araxos Airport

    The nearest airport.

Distances are approximate, as given on the villa’s listing.

Where exactly is the villa?
In Glyfada, Fokida (Municipality of Dorida), on the north coast of the Corinthian Gulf, facing the little island of Trizonia. Nafpaktos is about 24 km away.
How many guests does it sleep?
The villa has 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, with one double and four single beds plus two sofa beds. Ideal for families and groups — tell us how many you are and we will suggest the layout.
Is the pool private?
Yes — the large pool is exclusively for the villa’s guests, with loungers, poufs and shaded pergola lounges around it. It is open seasonally.
What are check-in and check-out times?
Check-in is from 15:30 to 18:00 and check-out from 09:00 to 10:00.
Are pets allowed?
Yes, on request and at no extra charge.
Is there a cot?
Yes, a cot is always available for children up to 2 years old, free of charge. Let us know in good time about anything your child needs.
Do I need a car?
It helps. Glyfada is a small, quiet village; with a car you easily reach Sergoula, Monastiraki, Nafpaktos and Delphi. There is free private parking at the villa.
How do I get to Trizonia?
By the local boat from Glyfada beach. No vehicles are allowed on the island; you will find tavernas with fresh fish, a beach bar and the beaches of Punta and Aspra Halikia.
How do I book?
Send us your dates from the «Booking request» card (it opens WhatsApp or Viber with the message ready), call us, or book directly on Booking.com.
